description: This file defines the EmpPictureDecorator class that adds additional functionality to the EmpPicture entity, including managing employee pictures and retrieving picture data as strings.

classes.name: EmpPictureDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the EmpPicture entity, managing employee picture data and interactions with related entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes the decorator with an EmpPicture instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the EmpPicture based on employee number.
